batches.brief: Convert the two CUSTBILL feed producers into one Lakeflow landing leg on ow_tp.ow_tp_custbill.custbill_feed. Units: custbill_sftp_ingest (etl/legacy-extra/jobs/sftp_ingest_poll.ksh — SFTP drop CUSTBILL*.dat size-settle poll, cp to incoming, archive copy; drops lock/hostname quirks) and custbill_oracle_extract (etl/legacy-extra/tools/oracle_custbill_extract.py — deterministic OW_BILLING.INVOICE_HEADER extract, batch_no=ns_batch_no(ns) OR tenant_id=ADMIN_TENANT_ID, NFKD-transliterated 65-char records, atomic tmp→replace, aborts whole file on amount >999,999,999,999c). Both write the same landing surface by contract (D6) — same batch co-schedules them, not sequencing: split into custbill_feed_mainframe/_oracle is a standing plan alternative, not needed at 18.8k rows. Preserve the 65-char record byte layout and feed_file/line_no lineage keys. Read .migration/units/custbill_sftp_ingest/mapping_spec.json and .migration/units/custbill_oracle_extract/mapping_spec.json. Source: oracle via OW_BILLING_RO_DSN (read-only, no package EXECUTE) + SFTP drop (fixture-generated files). Gates: row_parity + record byte-identity vs pinned replay; evidence .migration/recon/custbill_feed/.
